name: 21 CFR Part 11 and Audit Trails for AI
blurb: Electronic records, signatures and audit trail rules as they apply to AI.
title: 21 CFR Part 11 and Audit Trails for AI
answer: AI systems that create or change GxP records fall under the same electronic records rules as other software: Part 11 in the United States and Annex 11 in the EU. Audit trails must capture operator entries and actions that create, modify or delete records, keep the earlier information, and be retained for inspection. For AI that means logging prompts, outputs and human approvals, not just final records.

reading.body:
AI systems that create or change GxP records fall under the same electronic records rules as any other software, and their audit trails must capture prompts, outputs and human approvals, not just final records.

The rule itself is not new. 21 CFR 11.10 has required secure, computer generated, time stamped audit trails for electronic records since 1997, and EU GMP Annex 11 has required audit trails to be considered on the basis of risk for GMP relevant changes and deletions since 2011. What is new is the object being logged. A conventional system writes a record once and the trail records who changed it. A model can generate an output that becomes a record, and the trail has to reach back through the input, the model version and the approver to make that output defensible.

That is why the practical instruction is to design AI tools so every output that becomes a record is traceable to its input, model version and approver. The audit trail requirement keeps the earlier information rather than overwriting it, and it is retained for inspection. For a life sciences team this turns logging from an afterthought into a design constraint on the tool itself.

The data covers two regulatory anchors and one design implication. It does not cover how any specific vendor implements this, what an inspector will accept as a sufficient trail for a model output, or how retention periods are set. Those questions sit with the validation and Annex 11 material rather than here.

sections.body: Design AI tools so every output that becomes a record is traceable to its input, model version and approver.
